manaNeeded: {0} plus the mana cost of the creature in your hand
easyPrerequisites: All-Fates Stalker must be exiled by Changeling Hero, and Fiend Hunter must begin in hand. (This starting order is not fixed, and their initial positions may be interchanged as necessary.)
description:
Cast Fiend Hunter for its mana cost.
When Fiend Hunter enters, it exiles Changeling Hero until Fiend Hunter leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Fiend Hunter's ETB.
When Changeling Hero leaves the battlefield, All-Fates Stalker is returned from exile to the battlefield.
When All-Fates Stalker enters, it exiles Fiend Hunter until All-Fates Stalker leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of All-Fates Stalker's ETB.
When Fiend Hunter leaves the battlefield, Changeling Hero is returned from exile to the battlefield.
When Changeling Hero enters, it exiles All-Fates Stalker until Changeling Hero leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Changeling Hero's ETB.
When All-Fates Stalker leaves the battlefield, Fiend Hunter is returned from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
